---
title: "Study 1: Point duration in English-learners, ASL-learners and homesigners"
subtitle: "Reliability of semantic-role coding"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: false
---

Agreement between the original coder and a second coder on the semantic role
of the referent of each point, for the subset of points coded twice in each
group. Agreement is the percentage of points given the same role; Cohen's
kappa corrects that percentage for agreement expected by chance from each
coder's use of the categories.


```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r functions}
library(knitr)

cohen_kappa <- function(a, b) {
  levels <- sort(unique(c(a, b)))
  tab <- table(factor(a, levels), factor(b, levels))
  po <- sum(diag(tab)) / sum(tab)
  pe <- sum(rowSums(tab) * colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)^2
  (po - pe) / (1 - pe)
}

# Points coded by both coders: blank codes count as missing, and one
# misspelled category is corrected.
both_coded <- function(a, b) {
  clean <- function(x) { x[x %in% ""] <- NA; x[x %in% "intrument"] <- "instrument"; x }
  a <- clean(a); b <- clean(b)
  keep <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
  data.frame(coder_1 = a[keep], coder_2 = b[keep])
}

agreement <- function(d, group) {
  data.frame(group = group, points = nrow(d), agreed = sum(d$coder_1 == d$coder_2),
             percent = 100 * mean(d$coder_1 == d$coder_2),
             kappa = cohen_kappa(d$coder_1, d$coder_2))
}
```

```{r reliability}
english <- read.csv("data/reliability_english.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
english <- english[english$reliability_dataset_inclusion %in% "reliability_code" &
                     english$modality == "Points", ]
english <- both_coded(english$semantic_cat, english$semantic_cat_reliability)

asl <- read.delim("data/reliability_asl.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
asl <- both_coded(asl$semantic_category_AG, asl$semantic_category_ZL)

homesign <- read.csv("data/reliability_homesign.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
homesign <- both_coded(homesign$semantic_cat, homesign$reliability_semantic_category)

kable(rbind(agreement(english, "English-learners"),
            agreement(asl, "ASL-learners"),
            agreement(homesign, "Homesigners")),
      digits = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 2), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r confusion}
table(original = homesign$coder_1, second = homesign$coder_2)
table(original = asl$coder_1, second = asl$coder_2)
table(original = english$coder_1, second = english$coder_2)
```
